lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical high-contrast white lines are visible. Spacing is tightest at the anterior (shoulder) region, becoming wider and more regular across the central torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most lines (11 and 12) exhibit significant fragmentation, terminating early or transitioning into disconnected segments near the dorsal midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, appearing in a non-linear, high-density grouping above the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align in a vertical/diagonal sequence, mirroring the trajectory of the primary torso lines.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark-to-black distal limb pigmentation forming a 'sock' effect above the hooves; large, rounded ears with white interior focal points.
